newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse consolidates its upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two-hour session on Wednesday 0.22 percent higher, boosted mainly by steel mill SONASID, Wafabank and ONA group, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 440.95 from 439.98 points on Tuesday.

"Usual leading stocks boosted the bourse but there is no special happening...It is the end of the year and as there is no financial event the market is rather quiet," Younes Benjelloun, a broker at Casablanca Finance Intermediation told Reuters.
SONASID, which was floated on the bourse on July 2, was up six dirhams to close at 336 from 330 on Monday.
Wafabank, a very liquid stock, fell five dirhams to close at 550 from 555 dirhams.

Wafabank has purchased Spanish Uniban bank last week but the final agreement would be sealed when Uniban's general assembly meets on December 30, and after approval by the monetary authorities, officials said.
Uniban was up one dirham to 113 dirhams, brokers said.
Credit firm Credor CRD.CS which was recently introduced on the stock market, shed two dirhams to close at 453 dirhams.
ONA Group, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, gained one dirham to 506 dirhams.
ONA has diversified stakes in more than 100 companies and a capitalisation of more than 8.3 billion dirhams.
Total traded volume on the official market was 34.6 million dirhams from 31 million dirhams on Tuesday.
